name: gst_rates
about: GST rate slabs by period. An invoice uses the slabs in force on ITS date; a credit note uses its original invoice's rate. Special rates (precious metals / stones) stay as they are.

rows.note: Before GST 2.0. Compensation cess applied on top for some goods.
GST 2.0 (56th GST Council, 3 Sep 2025): 12% and 28% slabs removed; 0.25% and 3% special rates continue. Rate notification numbers not read on the primary text.

Health Security se National Security Cess (HSNS Act No. 35 of 2025) on pan masala and similar goods - administered by CBIC (HSNS Cess Notifications 01-03/2026). Start date of the switch from compensation cess is from secondary sources.
